frontend: FCEUX 2.6.6 (Homebrew build, Qt GUI), input from an FM2 movie played by its Lua engine (--loadlua, movie.play)

rom.name: Link no Bouken - The Legend of Zelda 2 (Japan) (Rev 1) (Collector's Edition).fds

input: work/standalone/tools/gen_fceux_fds.py: the retro-run script as an FM2 movie (pad 1 per frame; reset = command 1; flip = command 4 eject, 8 select side, 4 insert, 30 frames apart), played read-only from Lua at turbo speed; screenshots and emu.exit from Lua. FCEUX's Lua has no disk-side call, its movies do

layout.name: <ROM file name without extension>.fds
layout.content: the whole disk as the game left it: raw 65500-byte sides, no fwNES header (also when the ROM has one)
layout.written: when the game is closed (emu.exit here), and only if the game wrote to the disk; read back instead of the ROM on the next load

note: FDS BIOS disksys.rom in the FCEUX base folder. Byte-identical to fceumm's .srm for this game (same container: whole headerless image). FCEUX segfaults (rc 139) on some exits, after the file is written.
